items.label: Urban Unmarked Road Speed Limit
items.value: 50 km/h

items.label: Slow Lane & Narrow Undivided Road Speed Limit
items.value: 40 km/h

items.label: Railroad Level Crossing Approach Speed
items.value: 15 km/h or less (Stop if red light flashes)

items.label: Tunnel & Mountain Road Speed Limit
items.value: Follow posted signs; maintain headlights on

items.label: Freeway Small Car Safe Distance Formula
items.value: Speed (km/h) ÷ 2 = Distance in meters (100 km/h = 50m; Double in rain/fog)

items.label: Freeway Large Truck Safe Distance Formula
items.value: Speed (km/h) - 50 = Distance in meters (100 km/h = 50m)

items.label: Speed vs. Braking Distance Physics
items.value: Braking distance ∝ Speed² (Doubling speed = 4x braking distance)

items.label: Pedestrian Crosswalk Stopping Distance
items.value: Stop at least 3 meters (4 zebra stripes width) before crosswalk

items.label: Turn Signal Advance Distance
items.value: Activate turn signals at least 30 meters prior to turning/lane change

items.label: Freeway Warning Triangle Distance
items.value: Place triangle 100 meters behind broken-down vehicle (30-100m ordinary roads)

items.label: Prohibited Stopping Zone Distance
items.value: Prohibited within 10 meters of intersections, bus stops, or hydrants

category: 📱 Complete NT$ Fine Amounts & License Penalties

items.label: Running Red Light Fine (Car & Motorcycle)
items.value: NT$1,800 to NT$5,400 fine + 3 demerit points

items.label: Handheld Mobile Phone Fine (Car)
items.value: NT$3,000 fine for operating handheld device while driving

items.label: Handheld Mobile Phone Fine (Motorcycle)
items.value: NT$1,000 fine for operating handheld phone while riding

items.label: Cigarette Smoking While Driving Fine
items.value: NT$1,200 fine if affecting safety of others

items.label: Driving Without License Fine
items.value: NT$6,000 to NT$24,000 fine + Vehicle impoundment

items.label: Driving with Suspended/Revoked License
items.value: NT$6,000 to NT$24,000 fine + Immediate vehicle impoundment

items.label: Hit-and-Run Fleeing Scene (Injury/Death)
items.value: Permanent driver license revocation + criminal prosecution

items.label: Demerit Points License Suspension Cap
items.value: Accumulating 12 demerit points in 1 year = 2 months suspension

items.label: Lending Driver's License Penalty
items.value: Driver's license suspension for 3 months

items.label: Failing to Yield to Emergency Sirens Fine
items.value: NT$3,600 fine + Driver's license revocation

items.label: Failing to Yield to Pedestrians on Crosswalk
items.value: NT$1,200 to NT$6,000 fine + 3 demerit points

items.label: Spilling / Unsecured Cargo Falling Fine
items.value: NT$3,000 to NT$18,000 fine

items.label: Administrative Fine BAC Limit
items.value: 0.15 mg/L breath alcohol or 0.03% BAC

items.label: Criminal Offense Prosecution BAC Limit
items.value: 0.25 mg/L breath alcohol or 0.05% BAC

items.label: Car Drunk Driving Fine (First Offense)
items.value: NT$30,000 to NT$120,000 + License suspension

items.label: Motorcycle Drunk Driving Fine (First Offense)
items.value: NT$15,000 to NT$90,000 + License suspension

items.label: Refusing Sobriety Breathalyzer Test Fine
items.value: NT$180,000 + License revocation + Impoundment

items.label: Repeat Drunk Driving Window (10 Years)
items.value: Max fine + License revocation + Public photo/name disclosure

items.label: Passengers Riding with Drunk Driver Fine
items.value: NT$6,000 to NT$15,000 joint penalty (Ages 18+, except seniors 70+)

items.label: Ignition Interlock Device (Alcohol Lock)
items.value: Mandatory installation upon re-applying for license after DUI

items.label: Motorcycle Cargo Rear Extension Limit
items.value: Max 50 cm beyond rear wheel axle

items.label: Motorcycle Cargo Width Extension Limit
items.value: Max 10 cm beyond handlebar outer edges

items.label: Small Light Motorcycle Weight Limit
items.value: Max 30 kg

items.label: Regular Light Motorcycle Weight Limit
items.value: Max 60 kg

items.label: Heavy Motorcycle Weight Limit
items.value: Max 90 kg

items.label: Car Cargo Height Limit
items.value: Max 1.5x vehicle width, not exceeding 2.85 meters

items.label: Minimum Tire Tread Depth (Car)
items.value: 1.6 mm

items.label: Minimum Tire Tread Depth (Motorcycle)
items.value: 1.0 mm

items.label: Towing Rope Distance & Yellow Flag
items.value: Towing rope 3 to 5 meters with a yellow flag in middle

items.label: First Aid Priority Order
items.value: 1. Open Airway (B) → 2. Control Bleeding (A) → 3. Immobilize Fractures (C)

items.label: CPR Compression to Ventilation Ratio
items.value: 30 Chest Compressions : 2 Rescue Breaths (30:2)

items.label: CPR Chest Compression Rate & Depth
items.value: 100 to 120 compressions per minute; 5 to 6 cm depth

items.label: Suspected Spinal Trauma Airway Method
items.value: Jaw-Thrust maneuver (do NOT tilt head or move neck)

items.label: Brain Damage Window Without Oxygen
items.value: 4 to 6 minutes without oxygen causes irreversible brain damage

items.label: Unconscious Crash Victim Rule
items.value: Do NOT move unconscious casualty unless danger of fire/explosion

items.label: Railroad Breakdown SOS 3-Step Action
items.value: 1. Press Red Emergency Button → 2. Push vehicle clear → 3. Run clear

items.label: Straight vs. Turning Priority
items.value: Straight-going vehicle has absolute priority over turning vehicle

items.label: Left Turn vs. Right Turn Priority
items.value: Left-turning vehicle MUST yield to right-turning vehicle

items.label: Equal Width Unsignalized Intersection
items.value: Yield to vehicle approaching from your RIGHT side

items.label: Roundabout Traffic Priority
items.value: Entering vehicles MUST yield to traffic inside the roundabout

items.label: Solid Red Line Road Marking
items.value: No temporary stopping or parking 24 hours a day

items.label: Solid Yellow Line Road Marking
items.value: No parking 7 AM to 8 PM (temporary stopping <3 min allowed)

items.label: Double Solid Yellow Line
items.value: No crossing, straddling, or U-turns under any circumstances

items.label: Inverted White Triangle Road Marking
items.value: Yield line (Slow down and yield right-of-way to main road traffic)
